name: Aboki
role: THE LOCKED REFERENCE for the Aboki and Akpos skit series
rule: NEVER generate this character from text twice. Every still that needs him uses --ref character.png (add sheet.png for a turn or an expression, and skit-duo/duo.png when both are in frame); every clip is image-to-video from a frame that already contains him.
role_in_skit: the doubter: burned by YouTube courses before, sceptical, won over by the end

style.look: flat 2D cartoon stick figure, thick even black outlines, flat colour fills, one soft grey crescent of shading on the side of the head, no gradients, no 3D
style.backdrop: #E5DDD2 warm off-white paper (sampled from the reference)
style.shared_build: very large round off-white head (about a third of total height), short-sleeved t-shirt hanging straight to the hips, thin black stick arms and legs, solid black mitten hands with defined fingers, flat black oval shoes

design.identity_markers: must appear in every shot: (1) bald round head, no hair, no hat; (2) small solid black dot eyes; (3) thin eyebrows, one raised higher; (4) orange t-shirt
design.default_expression: quietly sceptical, one eyebrow up, small 'o' mouth (curious, not angry)
design.faces: left when paired; stands on the RIGHT of frame

voice.name: Alex Oke (shared Nigerian voice, 'Skit' in the ElevenLabs account)
voice.source: build-with-ai-videos v6-magic, approved take a (doubter role); shared/audio/config.json cast.v6.a.doubter

drift_seen: the first duo attempt gave him an angry frown. Say 'curious and sceptical, NOT angry' when he is in frame.

generation.prompt: Using the reference image, draw ONLY the character on the RIGHT (the bald one in the orange t-shirt), alone. Keep his design identical to the reference: a very large round off-white bald head with a thick black outline and no hair, no hat; two small solid black dot eyes; one thin eyebrow raised higher than the other; a small round "o" mouth, a quietly sceptical expression; a short-sleeved orange t-shirt (#EC8215) that hangs straight to the hips; thin black stick arms and long thin black stick legs; solid black mitten-like hands with defined fingers; flat black oval shoes. Same height and same head size as the other character in the reference. Head is about one third of his total height. Flat 2D cartoon stick-figure style exactly matching the reference image: thick clean black outlines of even weight, flat colour fills, one soft grey crescent of shading on the side of the round head, no gradients, no texture, no 3D. Plain warm off-white paper backdrop (#E5DDD2), seamless, nothing else in the scene, small soft grey contact shadow under the feet. Full body, whole character in frame with generous margin, standing centred, front three-quarter view, relaxed neutral standing pose with both arms hanging at his sides. EXACTLY ONE character in the image. No text, no watermark, no border.
